payload.test_method: The journal records debugger inspection of the retained crash and nearby system logs. Raw crash material, process identifiers, memory addresses, build identity and command-line paths are omitted.
payload.expected_result: Determine a reproducible trigger and evidence-supported fix without attributing the crash to an unrelated component.
payload.actual_result: The immediate null-base memory-read mechanism was identified. Missing debug symbols prevented function attribution. No confirmed fix or workaround was established.
payload.limitations: Only one retained Ghostty crash was found. Recurrence, trigger, function and wider applicability remain unknown. Other thread activity did not establish a graphics-driver or Omarchy cause; separate compositor crashes are not evidence of the same fault.
payload.provenance: Sanitized journal-imported diagnostic observation; not an upstream bug confirmation.
payload.adverse_effects: The terminal process exited unexpectedly; this record does not establish data loss.

activation.details: No corrective change was established or activated by this investigation.

root_cause.rationale: A low-level failure mechanism does not identify the triggering code path or underlying cause.
